objetivo: Talk about habits using frequency expressions.

parejas.a: What’s a good habit you have?
parejas.b: I read every night before bed.

parejas.a: How often do you drink coffee?
parejas.b: I always drink coffee in the morning. Every day!
I often go for a walk after work, and I ___ exercise at home.
I usually study in the evening.

quiz.h: What do you say? You read every night.
o: I read every night before bed.

quiz.t: I ___ drink coffee in the morning.
I ___ study English in the evening.
I ___ go for a walk after work.
